OperationIdBody.description: Process instance plus local sequence; never a semantic or cache identity.

process_instance.description: Process-local instance locator; not a semantic identity or attestation.

ReviewInventoryGap.description: Explicit unavailable, omitted or unresolved selection premise.

reason.description: Recorded reason; no absence is promoted to a complete graph.

ReviewInventoryLink.description: An actual recorded relationship. Its missing target remains a gap.

role.description: Existing producer role, e.g. parent, shared_producer, waiter or background.

target.description: Exact member identity, never a display name.

ReviewInventoryMemberOutput.description: Immutable copied member metadata, with actual readable result-prefix facts.

generation.description: Recorded canonical generation fence, independent of current pointer drift.

key.description: Exact identity in this supplied selection.

links.description: Actual links supplied by the relationship owner.

occurrence.description: Original occurrence ordinal when this is study membership.

operation.description: Exact diagnostic operation, including pre-handle failures.

outcome.description: Actual original outcome, including failure/cancellation when retained.

readable_prefix.description:
Actual recorded readable prefix/fence. Canonical attempts use close-generation here,
which is never a row count or evidence of an empty result; None means unavailable.

result_manifest.description: Exact closed result manifest. None means not known, not an empty result.

role.description: Existing producer role, not a fabricated global tree classification.

terminal.description: Actual terminal fact at selection time.

description: One exact immutable selection page. Re-reading it performs no live lookup.

gaps.description: Selection-level gaps remain available on every page.

members.description: Actual selected members, including exact empty pages.

next.description: Next offset only when another retained member exists.

title: ReviewInventoryPageOutput
